# Instance on Points

Places a transformed copy of splat geometry at every selected anchor.

`lfs.instance_on_points` · Instances

## How to use

Points accepts point clouds, mesh vertices and splat centres; Instance accepts splats only.\
Rotation uses Euler degrees. Scale accepts one number or three axis multipliers: 1 keeps size, 0 collapses an axis, and negative values mirror it.\
Splat shape and view-dependent SH colour transform together. Output is limited to 50 million splats.\
Negative multipliers use their magnitude for size and mirror positions, orientation and SH colour. A collapsed transform leaves SH colour unchanged.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Points | `Points` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry whose elements provide the anchor positions. |
| Instance | `Instance` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Splat geometry to duplicate around each anchor; other geometry is not supported. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Anchors with values of 0.5 or more receive an instance. Unconnected selects every anchor. |
| Rotation | `Rotation` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 1; accepts per-element values | Euler angles around X, Y and Z in degrees, evaluated at each anchor; zero keeps the orientation. |
| Scale | `Scale` | lfs.vector | [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Scale accepts one number or three axis multipliers: 1 keeps size, 0 collapses an axis, and negative values mirror it. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Realized splats with transformed positions, shapes and SH colours. |
